# Vendored files

Bundled so the app works offline. Do not edit them.

- `tone/Tone.js`: Tone.js 14.8.49, `build/Tone.js` from the npm package `tone@14.8.49`, unmodified. MIT licence (https://github.com/Tonejs/Tone.js). Third-party notices are in `tone/Tone.js.LICENSE.txt`.
- `salamander/*.mp3`: 20 notes (C, D#, F#, A in octaves 3 to 7) of the Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm, as published in https://github.com/Tonejs/audio (`salamander/`). Licensed CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
- `guitar/*.mp3`: 18 notes of a steel-string acoustic guitar, every other semitone from E2 to D5 (`E2`, `Fs2`, `Gs2`, `As2`, `C3`, `D3`, … `C5`, `D5`). Recorded by the University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios (Musical Instrument Samples, http://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/), as edited and published by Nicholaus Brosowsky in https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments (`samples/guitar-acoustic/`). That repository licenses its samples CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Files are unmodified; the odd semitones of the set (F2, G2, … C#5) and its D2 and D#2 are not included. Each file was checked to be within 8 cents of its note.
